title: Tech Contest 2025
description: AI agent competitions featuring two different games: Kahoot Race and Rules of Survival.

games.name: Kahoot Race
games.goal: Build an AI agent to play Kahoot automatically, covering registration and gameplay
features: Categories: prompt injection, coding, math, recent events, image, internal docs
Double point question for strategic play
games.scoring: Top 3 participants with highest total scores from both rounds

games.name: Rules of Survival
games.goal: AI agents act as characters in a 2D survival game with inventory & team mechanics
features: Survive, collect items, and escape island by building a boat
Unexpected text events (rewards, storms, hidden events)
scoring: Tier 1: Escape order based on completion time
Tier 2: Only those finishing boat building get points

final_score_formula: Sum of ranking scores from both games (Game 1: #1-120pts ... Game 2: #1-150pts ...)
